alt: Churn risk ticket page showing a low-risk result
title: Customer Churn Prediction
description: Food-delivery churn prediction app with a FastAPI backend and a plain HTML/CSS/JS front end. The demo shown runs on a rule-based fallback when no trained model file is loaded.
overview: Predicts whether a food-delivery customer is likely to stop ordering, using occupation, monthly income and survey answers about their delivery experience. A FastAPI backend serves the predictions and a plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript front end shows the result as a printed-style risk ticket.
features: Order intake form with occupation, income and survey responses
Churn risk percentage and risk level on a ticket-style result
FastAPI backend with automatic interactive API docs
Automated API tests written with pytest
Models explored in the notebook: Logistic Regression, Random Forest and XGBoost
A clearly labelled rule-based demo mode is used when the trained model file is not loaded
status: Working demo. The deployed version needs the trained model files added; no accuracy figures are published here.

alt: News text box with a prediction result
title: Fake News Detector
description: Fake news detection project. The current GitHub version is a rule-based scorer built with FastAPI that looks at wording and source patterns. It flags risk and is not a fact-checker.
overview: A local misinformation-risk checker. You paste an article and it scores wording patterns such as sensational language, clickbait phrases, absolute claims and unverified source domains, then shows which signals matched. It is a prompt to take a second look, not a fact-checker.
features: Heuristic risk score with a per-signal breakdown
History of past checks with pagination and a source-domain filter
Related news coverage and a live news dashboard through NewsAPI (needs an API key)
Light and dark mode
No external AI or LLM APIs are used
status: Working locally. User accounts are not implemented and storage is a simple JSON file.

title: VELOOP Rewards
description: Rewards web app with a dashboard summary and reward claiming, built with React, Node.js, Express and MongoDB Atlas. Demo account only; still in progress.
overview: A rewards web app where a member completes activities and claims rewards. The dashboard shows a rewards summary, available balance and tasks claimed, and claimed tasks are saved in MongoDB through a REST API.
features: Overview dashboard with a rewards summary
Earn Rewards page with demo tasks: daily check-in, complete a task and try a new feature
Balance and tasks-claimed counters saved in MongoDB
Backend connection status shown on the page
Light and dark mode toggle
status: In progress. Runs with a demo account only.

title: Course Craft
description: Responsive e-learning website front end for programming courses, built on a free HTML template. The content shown is demo content.
overview: A multi-page front end for an online learning site that offers free programming courses. It has a home page with a course search bar, about, courses, course detail, features, team, testimonial and contact pages, and a sign-up form. It is built on a free HTML template, and the sample content on the pages is placeholder content.
features: Eight linked pages with shared navigation
Course search bar and sign-up form layout
Contact page with a message form layout
Responsive layout
status: Front end only. Counters, course names and contact details shown are demo content.

alt: Title card for the AI Citizen Fraud Shield project
title: AI Citizen Fraud Shield
description: Streamlit app with scam detection, digital arrest awareness, a fraud chatbot and a dashboard, built for ET AI Hackathon 2.0.
overview: A Streamlit app built for ET AI Hackathon 2.0 to help citizens recognise fraud. It has four pages: a scam message detector, a digital arrest scam detector, an AI fraud awareness chatbot and a dashboard of cybercrime trends in India.
features: Scam message detector using a DistilBERT model, with a training script and dataset in the repo
Digital arrest scam detector that lists the fraud patterns it finds
Fraud awareness chatbot using the Google Gemini API
Dashboard with cybercrime growth and state-wise charts and a map
status: Hackathon project (certificate of participation). No accuracy figures are published here.

alt: Weather app showing current weather for Secunderabad
title: Advanced Weather App
description: Flask web app that shows current weather for a searched city using the OpenWeatherMap API.
overview: A small web app where you search for a city and see its current weather: temperature, humidity, wind speed and a short description with an icon, fetched from the OpenWeatherMap API.
features: City search form
Temperature in Celsius, humidity and wind speed
Weather description and icon
Error message when a city is not found

alt: Student performance predictor showing a predicted final mark
title: Student Performance Predictor
description: Flask app that predicts final marks from study hours, attendance and previous marks using Linear Regression, trained on a small sample dataset.
overview: A machine learning web app that predicts a student's final marks from study hours, attendance percentage and previous marks, using a Linear Regression model.
features: Simple input form for the three factors
Instant predicted final marks
Linear Regression model saved with Pickle and loaded by the Flask app
status: Learning project trained on a small sample dataset, so predictions are illustrative.

alt: Media Processing Service API documentation page
title: Zaalima Python Projects
description: Team internship repository from the Zaalima Python program, led by Sugunesh Loganathan, including a media processing microservice.
overview: The team repository from the Zaalima Python internship program, led by Sugunesh Loganathan. Project 1 is a Distributed Media Processing Microservice that accepts secure file uploads and processes images in the background while tracking job status.
features: Secure file uploads
Background image processing
Asynchronous task execution
Job status tracking
status: Team project; the repository belongs to the team lead.
